decisions.base: Combine #1-396 Series 1 with #397-660 Series 2, equal base probability.
decisions.rookies: TCDB rookie index contains 38 records. Treat RC only when independently verified by number and source subject/team.
decisions.cyberstats: 396-card partial parallel, one card per standard original pack; not every Base number has a CyberStats parallel.
decisions.inserts: League Leaders 50, Own the Game instant winners 30, Stadium Club First Day Issue 270, Total Bases 15, Walmart pack-issued sweepstakes entry one card.
decisions.excluded: Seven CyberStats Season in Review and ten Opening Day cards are factory-set exclusives, not pack issued. Do not include them in normal VCS packs.
decisions.variants: Printing variations are one collectible per physical card number, with no fabricated subjects. Preserve source-specific independent insert identities.
decisions.odds: Historical original-series and channel-dependent odds retained as reference, require unified VCS pack QA. CyberStats 1:1, League Leaders retail 1:6 / jumbo 1:3, First Day Issue series 2 hobby 1:4 (DP series 1 hobby 1:36), Total Bases series 2 1:36, Own the Game 1:120.
decisions.names: Whole-delimiter token cleanup only, never truncate legitimate surnames.
decisions.pack: Four VCS cards per pack, 24 packs per box; product unreleased.
decisions.release: Blocked on checklist QA, authentic art, pricing and odds normalization.
